capture.zh: SPT面板选择螺旋星系→凯洛亚，前往珊瑚海礁挑战，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 魔焰猩猩秒杀流；或光母鸡（光蘑菇）消强→塔克林龙之威仪不断弱化→黑电自杀→圣光天马强化后大招打出1W+；谱尼可扛断流怒啸的固定伤害。

engine_notes: immune_pct_damage: 海洋之心 and other 'lose X% of current/max HP' (大比例扣血) skills deal no damage / miss against this boss (ops pct_damage, and 同生共死-style HP-equalising scripts).
Immune to DoT statuses (烧伤、冻伤、中毒) and control skills (灵魂干涉); 同生共死、寄生种子 ineffective. Stage-downs on it DO work (塔克林 strategy).
Innate boost (天生强化) — stats not stated; atk+2, as unstated innate boosts are atk+2 (user decision 2026-10-19). Frequently uses 水之结界 (all foe stats -1).
断流怒啸: 10% chance of +150 fixed damage (matches skill 12660).
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
source_note: 4399 SPT page 2012-03-17: skills 异光幻流/断流怒啸/破浪念闪/水之结界; no level/HP given.
